AA.name: Chakra Magic
AA.description: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount.
AA.differences: When casted on an ally, also applies the effects on self. Is retroactive, meaning the next abilities that are cast within certain amount of seconds will also have its cooldown reduced.
AA.superUpgrade: Super: -4s reduced cooldown, and applies a basic dispel on targeted hero. Reduces ally cooldowns by an additional 2s.
AA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Blinding Light. Chakra Magic also reduces the cooldown of ultimates.

AA.name: Firesnap Cookie
AA.description: The hero feeds a potent cookie to themselves or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
AA.superUpgrade: Super: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, getting increased jump range and launching a Mortimer Kiss to the landing destination. Heals units for 200 and grants 200 max health.
AA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: For 3 seconds, the target gets thrown an additional Firesnap Cookie every 1 seconds.

AA.name: Mortimer Kisses
AA.description: The caster launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. The caster has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600.
AA.superUpgrade: Super: +20% slow, and +20 burn damage per second. Given Gobble Up ability.

AA.name: Nature's Call
AA.description: Spawn number of Treants under the command of the caster.
AA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Spawns a Treant when an enemy summon or illusion dies, and a Greater Treant when an enemy hero dies.

AA.name: Jingu Mastery
AA.description: The caster's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, the caster earns four charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
AA.superUpgrade: Super: Grants Echo Sabre and +130 damage.
AA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Spawns a stone soldier near you every 2s.
